faqs.q: Does Finance Flow require an active internet connection to generate GST invoices?
faqs.a: No! Finance Flow is built with a 100% offline-first architecture. It stores your company data, customer lists, inventory, and invoices locally on your computer in an encrypted database. You never need an active internet connection to print invoices or record daily sales.

faqs.q: What types of printers are supported by the Finance Flow software suite?
faqs.a: Finance Flow supports all standard printers: 2-inch and 3-inch thermal receipt printers (USB, Bluetooth, LAN) as well as regular A4/A5 laser and inkjet printers for detailed GST tax invoices with terms and bank details.

faqs.q: How does Esyus Technology handle software updates and data safety?
faqs.a: All desktop applications include automated local database backup mechanisms. Updates can be installed seamlessly without touching or overwriting your stored customer and invoice records.

faqs.q: Can Esyus Technology build custom features or integrations for our business?
faqs.a: Yes! In addition to our off-the-shelf software packages, we offer end-to-end custom software development. Whether you need specific receipt printer hardware integration, custom reports, or cloud synchronization, our team will engineer it to your exact specifications.

faqs.q: How can I download and test Finance Flow or Bharat Yatra Sathi?
faqs.a: You can download the installers directly from the 'Download Applications' section on this website. Our desktop installers are packaged as easy-to-use Windows .exe setup files, and Android applications are available as secure APKs.
